name: docs-ssh
description: Self-hosted SSH docs server serving 130+ documentation sources (docs + API specs) as searchable markdown over SSH

scripts.validate: pnpm generate:tools && git diff --exit-code commands/tools.sh commands/tools-pi.sh && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.generate:tools: node --import tsx/esm src/commands/generate-tools-sh.ts && node --import tsx/esm src/commands/generate-tools-pi-sh.ts
scripts.docker:build: DOCS_OUT_DIR=./docs DOCS_WORK_DIR=/tmp/docs-ssh-work DOCS_MAX_AGE=0 node --import tsx/esm src/index.ts && docker build --build-arg DOCS_PREBUILT=true --build-arg VERSION="$(git describe --tags --always --dirty 2>/dev/null || echo dev)" -t docs-ssh:local .
scripts.docker:build:cached: DOCS_OUT_DIR=./docs DOCS_WORK_DIR=/tmp/docs-ssh-work node --import tsx/esm src/index.ts && docker build --build-arg DOCS_PREBUILT=true --build-arg VERSION="$(git describe --tags --always --dirty 2>/dev/null || echo dev)" -t docs-ssh:local .
scripts.release:patch: pnpm version patch -m 'release: v%s' && git push origin main --tags
scripts.release:minor: pnpm version minor -m 'release: v%s' && git push origin main --tags
scripts.release:major: pnpm version major -m 'release: v%s' && git push origin main --tags
